description: Current USD price of an ERC-20 token from DefiLlama (free, keyless): price + symbol + confidence, or null for unlisted/thin-market tokens. Well-covered chains only (eth, base, bnb, arb, op, avax, polygon, linea, mantle, sonic, unichain, sei, cronos).

chain.description: Chain to query. Accepts a slug (eth, base, arb, op, robinhood…), a common name (ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bsc), or a numeric chain ID (1, 8453). Call list_chains for all valid values.

name: get_token_price
